title: Nevada's 4th Congressional District election, 2026
description: The 2026 general election for Nevada's 4th Congressional District features Democratic incumbent Steven Horsford facing Republican nominee Cody Whipple. The district covers northern Clark County (including North Las Vegas) and extends into several rural central Nevada counties including Nye, Lincoln, Esmeralda, and Mineral. Horsford, first elected in 2012 and returning in 2018, serves on the House Ways & Means Committee and chaired the Congressional Black Caucus. Whipple, a fourth-generation Nevadan, rancher, and small business owner making his first run for office, won a three-way Republican primary on June 9, 2026, with nearly 62% of the vote. The Cook Political Report rates the race as 'Likely D,' though the district's competitiveness was highlighted by Kamala Harris carrying it by just two points in 2024 while Horsford outperformed her by five points.
polling_note: No specific general election head-to-head polls were found for this race as of mid-2026. The Cook Political Report rates NV-04 as 'Likely Democratic.'

candidates.name: Steven Horsford
candidates.summary: Steven Horsford is the Democratic incumbent U.S. Representative for Nevada's 4th Congressional District, first elected in 2012 and serving again since 2019 after defeating Cresent Hardy in a 2018 rematch. He served as Chair of the Congressional Black Caucus from 2023 to 2025 and sits on the House Ways & Means Committee, including its Health and Social Security subcommittees. Prior to Congress, he served in the Nevada State Senate from 2005 to 2013 and became the first African American Majority Leader in state history, and previously led the Culinary Training Academy, Nevada's largest job-training program.

candidates.name: Cody Whipple
candidates.summary: Cody Whipple is a fourth-generation Nevadan, small business owner, and rancher who won the Republican nomination for Nevada's 4th Congressional District in the June 9, 2026 primary with nearly 62% of the vote. He operates the family-owned Whipple Ranch in Hiko, Nevada and founded a digital two-way communication network company serving first responders and businesses across multiple states. A former Virginia Tech football scholarship athlete with a degree in Animal Science, Whipple has emphasized lowering the cost of living, supporting small businesses, border security, and parental control in education in his campaign.
